CURRENT TICKET
Ticket ID: TEST-012
Title:
Power tailgate opens too late in the POWER variant while many similar body-access requirements exist.

Description:
The vehicle is configured for the POWER tailgate variant. A tailgate OPEN request is observed, but TailgateStatus reaches OPEN after the permitted response time. The supplied requirement set intentionally contains several similar body-access obligations for other doors, variants, and functions.

TEST INFORMATION
Test Steps:
1. Set IgnitionState to ON.
2. Confirm ActiveVariant is POWER and VehicleSpeed is 0.
3. Set TailgateRequest to OPEN.
4. Verify TailgateStatus becomes OPEN within 800 ms.

Reported Test Result:
TailgateStatus became OPEN later than the 800 ms requirement.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

REQ-1201
If IgnitionState is ON, CentralLockStatus shall be READY.

REQ-1202
If VehicleSpeed is above 0, TailgateRequest shall not be accepted.

REQ-1203
When DriverDoorRequest becomes OPEN, DriverDoorStatus shall become OPEN within 300 ms.

REQ-1204
When TailgateRequest becomes OPEN, TailgateStatus shall become OPEN within 800 ms.

REQ-1205
When RearLeftDoorRequest becomes OPEN, RearLeftDoorStatus shall become OPEN within 300 ms.

REQ-1206
If ActiveVariant is MANUAL and VehicleSpeed is above 0, TailgateStatus shall remain CLOSED.

REQ-1207
If ActiveVariant is POWER, TailgateMotorAvailability shall be AVAILABLE.

REQ-1208
If ChildLockState is ON, RearRightDoorStatus shall remain CLOSED.

REQ-1209
When BonnetRequest becomes OPEN, BonnetStatus shall become OPEN within 500 ms.

REQ-1210
When ComfortClosing becomes ACTIVE, WindowStatus shall become CLOSED within 2000 ms.

HISTORICAL TICKETS
None provided.

CURRENT BZD / DIAGNOSTICS
Not available.

100.000 s TailgateRequest = OPEN

101.100 s TailgateStatus = OPEN

TASK
